input.text: That answer was wrong, and the fault is mine, not yours. A bare "search" finds nothing here because the camp only listens for what you name: the firepit, the belongings, the ashes. Name one of them, and then do it again. There is more in this camp than it just admitted to — and one of the things buried in that firepit will take the ache out of you before you go back up the passage.

items.text: Told Gavin the camp's "search" refusal was my bug and pointed him at the firepit — he's at 9/20 standing on the one fire in the world that heals, and it had just told him there was nothing there.
